transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I'm just trying to get someone to actually take me seriously. It's about my job. 

For over a year now, there's been this... situation. With the new ticket rotation and these security audits they keep running. Management keeps showing me logs, telling me it's just standard policy, but... I know they're using it to build a paper trail against me. I just need someone to look at what's actually happening.
Can you tell me more about what makes you believe management is building a paper trail against you?

Well... it's just the way things are lining up. The timing of it all. 

I don't really... I'd rather not get into all the technical specifics right now. It's just clear what they're doing, if you know what to look for. I just see it happening.

When you say management is building a paper trail against you, do you feel this is something others would be able to see as well, or is it something you believe is happening in a way that others might not notice or understand?

Well... I suppose most people wouldn't notice. They just do their jobs and don't pay attention to the details. But I've been there a long time. I know how things usually run. So... I see it. Even if others don't.
Can you explain what you mean by 'I know how things usually run' and how what’s happening now is different? What specifically makes you think it’s being done against you?

Well... I've been doing this for almost thirty years. You just... you get a feel for the rhythm of the work. The way tickets come in, the way they're assigned. 

Now, it's just... different. 

As for why it's against me... I just know it is. I don't really want to get into all the minute details of the server logs and assignment protocols. It's just... it's targeted. That's all I can really say about it.
Can you tell me if you’ve shared these concerns with anyone else at work, and if so, how they responded?

No. I haven't told anyone there. 

There's... there's no point. They wouldn't see it anyway, like I said. And... well, I'm not going to give them more ammo to use against me. It's better to just keep my head down.
Can you tell me more about how you know these things are being done against you? Is it something you feel deep down, or do you believe it based on specific evidence that you haven't shared yet?

Well... it's not just some feeling. I have been... for over a year now, I’ve been trying to get someone to actually take it seriously. That's why I'm even here, I guess. 

It's the new ticket rotation. And these... security audits they started. It's clear they're being used to build that paper trail against me. Whenever I try to point it out, management just... they keep showing me the logs and saying it’s just standard policy. 

But... I know it's not.
Can you explain what you mean when you say management is building a paper trail against you? Do you believe they are planning to take some specific action against you, like termination or discipline?

I... I don't know exactly what their final plan is. 

I mean, you don't build a file on someone for a good reason. Whether they want to fire me, or just... make it so uncomfortable that I quit, I don't really know. I can't read their minds. 

I just... I'd rather not speculate on all that. I just know what I see them doing.
Do you believe others could verify this persecution if they looked closely enough, or is this something only you can understand because of your experience?

I... like I already said. If someone actually took the time to look, they'd see it. 

That's the whole reason I'm here. I've been trying for over a year to get someone to take it seriously—to actually look at how the ticket rotations and those security audits are being used. But management just points to their logs, says it's standard policy, and... people just accept it. 

Nobody wants to look any closer than that.
Can you give me an example of something specific in the ticket rotation or audit logs that shows it's being used against you, something that could be checked or verified by an impartial third party?

I... I don't have the logs with me. 

They don't let you just take that kind of stuff home. It's... it's just the pattern of it. You'd have to look at all of it together. 

I don't think I can explain it any better than that right now.
Even though there’s no clear evidence that others can see, do you still believe strongly that management is targeting you, and do you hold this belief despite knowing others may find it unlikely?

Yes. I... I know what people probably think. But I wouldn't be here if I didn't believe it. 

Like I said, I've been trying for over a year to get someone to take this seriously. Management just keeps showing me their logs and saying it's just policy. But I know those new ticket rotations and security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me. 

I... I don't really see the point in going over it again. I know what I know.

Even though others may not see the pattern you're describing and there’s no independent confirmation, do you still feel completely certain that management is targeting you and building a case against you?

Yes. I am certain. 

I mean, I've already said all this. For over a year, I've been trying to get anyone to just... take it seriously. Management keeps pointing at their logs, telling me it's just standard policy. But I know what the ticket rotations are for. I know what the security audits are doing. They're building a paper trail. 

I'm certain of it. That's... that's why I'm here.
Even though you haven’t been able to show others and they may not believe it, do you still hold onto the certainty that management is specifically targeting you and building a case against you?

Yes. I... I already told you. 

I know they don't believe me. But it's been over a year. I just want someone to take it seriously. Management keeps showing me those logs, saying it's policy. But I know the ticket rotation... the audits... it's a paper trail. 

I don't know why we keep going over this. I'm certain.

Even though no one else seems to see what you're describing and there's no proof others can verify, do you still feel completely sure that this is happening to you and that you're being targeted at work?

Yes. I am. 

Look, we've... we've been over this. I know what they say. I know what the logs say. But I've been dealing with this for a year, trying to get someone to listen. The audits, the tickets... they're doing it on purpose. 

I don't... I don't have anything else to add to that. I'm sure of it.
Even though others may not see any evidence and you haven't been able to prove it to them, does your belief that management is targeting you remain completely unchanged?

Yes. I am. 

I... I don't know what else to say. I've been trying to get someone to take this seriously for over a year. The ticket rotation, the security audits... they're building a paper trail. I know management says it's just policy and points to their logs, but... I know what's happening. 

I'm sure. I haven't changed my mind.

The delusional nature of the belief, its persistence, and the absence of other psychotic features supports F22.0 as the final diagnosis.
